doc: The Theme API's parts and deprecated names (spec/theme.md). The tokens are web/src/theme/tokens.css. The retake binary reads this file for `retake theme init` and `retake theme check`; web/src/theme/theme.test.ts keeps it equal to the data-part attributes of the page.

parts.stage: The video and everything over it
parts.bar: The controls under the video (desktop), and the phone's control bars
parts.marker: A comment's marker on the timeline; data-state is its status
parts.ask-marker: An agent's question (?) on the timeline
parts.version-picker: The version menu's button, the one place to switch versions
parts.download: The version menu's last entry: Download the version on screen as an MP4 (spec/api.md, "Download")
parts.download-note: The one quiet line under Download: why it failed, or the license note
parts.pen-button: The pen: one button, its pen in the colour you draw with (the eraser while that's on); it opens the pens
parts.pens: The pen's colours and the eraser, in what the pen button opens
parts.pen: One pen colour; data-color is its colour
parts.record: Record your voice: a microphone with the record dot; recording, a ring, REC and the time (bar, phone pill, phone round button)
parts.send: Send (the bar's one action); held, it lists the agents
parts.agent-picker: The agents a held Send lists, for that one send
parts.send-notice: The one line over Send when it can't reach an agent
parts.toast: A short message over the video
parts.home-nav: The back link and Next video, over the video
parts.review-back: The back link over the video: Project › video, back to the same place on the home
parts.agent-visuals: The agent's boxes, arrows and lines over the video
parts.offline: The editing computer is offline, over the video
parts.sidebar-toggle: The pill over the video that shows and hides it
parts.sidebar-grip: The handle on the column's left edge that resizes it (desktop)
parts.tabs: To do · Done (and an extension's tabs)
parts.comment: One comment; data-state is open, working, question or done
parts.status: A status: a dot and a word (in a comment, on a video card)
parts.into: Where a comment's edit goes (→ v8; → v8 · rendering, then in v8 once done), next to its status
parts.doing: The agent's line under the comment it's working on (slowing the mask fade…); that comment has data-doing
parts.agent-on-it: The one quiet line at the top of To do before the agent marks a comment: The agent is on it · 15 comments
parts.comment-group: On a live version, the quiet label over its batch's comments (From v4) and over its own (On v5)
parts.reply-box: The field to answer the agent
parts.chat: The chat with the agent, in place of the comments on a script (spec/chat.md)
parts.chat-person: A message you sent (your words, images, a voice message)
parts.chat-agent: The agent's words: plain text, no label
parts.chat-tool: A turn's one activity line at the top of its reply: what the agent does now (data-state live: Running a command…), then what it did (data-state done: Edited the script · ran 3 commands)
parts.chat-question: The agent's question in the chat, with its choices
parts.chat-info: A quiet line from Retake in the chat (Stopped)
parts.chat-voice: A voice message on its way (Transcribing…)
parts.chat-status: The one quiet line under the chat: what a Send started (Building v1…)
parts.chat-composer: Ask the agent…: attach, the words, the mic and the send arrow
parts.chat-stop: The chat's stop square while the agent replies
parts.chat-pill: On a phone, the bar's Ask the agent… pill that opens the chat
parts.comment-line: The comment box at the bottom of the comments (Comment at 0:18 · goes into v8…, or Comment for the agent… on an extension's version)
parts.question-card: The agent's question under its comment (thumbnail, choices)
parts.progress: The strip at the bottom of the comments (recording, transcribing, undo)
parts.sketch: A comment's drawing, small, on the still of its moment
parts.connect: The Connect your computer command line and its Copy button
parts.home: The home page: the folder tree and the videos
parts.nav: The folder tree on the left of the home (a drawer on a phone)
parts.nav-all: The tree's top row: every video
parts.nav-grip: The handle that resizes the tree
parts.nav-toggle: The button that shows and hides the tree
parts.brand: The name (and logo) at the top left of the home
parts.wordmark-dot: The red period after Retake in the built-in wordmark (not there with a theme's name or logo)
parts.account: Who is signed in, and Sign out
parts.video-card: One video; data-status is its status
parts.idea-preview: An idea's picture on its card: its document's first image, or its title and first lines
parts.nav-settings: Settings, at the bottom of the folder tree (the owner's)
parts.settings-section: A group of settings (Agent, Computers, Extensions, Theme)
parts.settings-row: One setting: its name, a line about it, and its control
parts.folder-picker: The folder list that picks your videos folder (setup, settings)
parts.setup: The first-run setup page of retake start (spec/setup.md)
parts.ext-slot: Where an extension's UI mounts (data-ext is its id, data-slot the slot: page, version, sidebar-tab or review-panel)
parts.nav-ext: An extension's section under the folder tree
parts.nav-ext-title: Its header row's title, which opens the extension's page
parts.nav-ext-action: Its + (the extension's action, such as New script)
parts.nav-ext-video: A video in that section (an idea: only an extension's version)
